## Strongest current system statement

Fresh construction always finishes in the Lean model. Under the stated
guard conditions, its result represents exactly the specified finite
trees. A completed supported root reduction with empty inherited
constraints preserves that exact language. General reduction completion
and whole-library Haskell refinement remain open. Read
`notes-current-system-claim.md` for the full contracts.

## Exact value ancestry

`SourceCurrentClassRecursiveValueOrigins.Occurs` follows literal ordinary
row children. Its root retains the complete value. Each child retains
the canonical row lookup and exact natural child position. The path lists
child indices. Row indices remain separate receipts. The relation does
not follow union members, stored Mu bodies or observed unfolding rows.

`node` traces a recursive value in an actual completed node edit. It
retains the exact same value at the same child path in the input, or an
actual native/Head event contains that value at a residual ordinary path.
The result preserves full value identity, rather than only row fields.
An ordinary rebuild cannot create a recursive root. A selected child
retains its actual edit. Earlier child and row effects derive the support,
memo validity and writer history needed for that edit.

`SourceCurrentClassFoldRecursiveValueOrigins.children`, `list`,
`class_sources` and `fold` compose this result. The source keeps the same
forest slot and child path throughout the chronological fold. The event
case retains an actual earlier event and the same complete recursive
value. Each phase keeps its own captured forest and base heap. Initial
readiness, inventory admission, availability, class coherence, active
paths, domains, memo support, validity and native history remain explicit.
No false gate or Required Origin on a changed forest is assumed.

The proofs reuse the existing indexed native/Head event hierarchy. A Head
source follows the actual recursive body ancestry. A surviving value in
the exposed input uses that Head event. A value from a native call in
the body retains the body's own event. No unchanged-body claim is made.

## Actual first recursive reader

`SourceCurrentProjectionRecursiveEntry.Entry` indexes the exact Project,
Read, selected row position and complete row. Its root starts a read at
Mu or union. Its Head case retains the first actual recursive projection,
Head, body and remaining selected Spine. Its ordinary case follows the
same exact ProjectionFrame child call and operand read. Successful signed
selection supplies the natural child index. Equal sibling values cannot
replace that index.

`occurs` derives the exact recursive value at the retained ordinary child
prefix. It also derives the equation that splits the requested path into
that natural prefix and the remaining path. `first` constructs either
an ordinary Route or this first recursive Entry from the selected Spine.
Its path domain excludes a bare reference endpoint. Unrelated ordinary
siblings need not be closed.

`fold_first` starts from actual FoldReads, initial fold support and an
initial observation domain on the original forest. It takes the literal
Project from the fold's returned heap and the actual selected complete
Read. Actual fold effects derive final semantic and cost support,
availability and the observation domain. The projection producer derives
the selected Spine. The theorem then derives the reader's exact recursive
value and its source in the initial forest or an actual earlier event.
Neither the Spine nor the desired ancestry is a premise.

The ordinary alternative is a Route in the selected FINAL fold value.
It is not asserted to be an initial input row. The recursive alternative
retains exact initial-value or chronological-event ancestry. It does not
assert that every event value is plain. It does not derive a complete
projection of the unchanged whole event value through later class edits.
Physical support at a later semantic reader and causal native writer
lookup remain separate obligations for the native residual handoff.

The example invokes the actual node and singleton-fold producers. Both
must therefore return event witnesses. Their residual paths remain
